links.outcome: Expert-rated quality of six candidate LLMs compared on identical dental case questions
links.effect: Significant differences across all metrics; DeepSeek median 4.5/5 vs GPT 4.0, Gemini 4.0, Copilot 4.0, MedGemma 3.75, Llama 3.5.
links.quote: DeepSeek achieved the highest expert ratings, with a median score of 4.5/5, outperforming other models such as GPT (4.0/5), Gemini (4.0/5), Copilot (4.0/5), MedGemma (3.75/5), and Llama (3.5/5).

screen.reason: The study evaluates six LLMs on standardized dental case vignettes using expert ratings and automated metrics, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
